title: A Harbor for the Postcard
author: Mara Vane
blurb: Elodie Okafor, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
